# Authorization Standards

This directory contains standards for implementing authorization mechanisms, access control, and permission management across the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/security/authorization/README.md#std-sec-authz-001-authorization-implementation]

### STD-SEC-AUTHZ-001: Authorization Implementation

Standards for implementing authorization mechanisms including RBAC, ABAC, permission models, access control policies, and fine-grained authorization enforcement.
page_texts.5:
[standards/security/authorization/README.md#std-sec-authz-002-gainwell-enterprise-user-roles-architecture-standard]

### STD-SEC-AUTHZ-002: Gainwell Enterprise User Roles Architecture Standard

Defines six enterprise role archetypes, a four-tier product extension model, governance rules, lifecycle management, and separation-of-duties constraints for consistent role engineering across all Gainwell products and DDI engagements.
page_texts.6:
[standards/security/authorization/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Consistent authorization approaches across systems
- Proper access control and permission management
- Principle of least privilege enforcement
- Clear separation of duties
- Auditable access decisions
